_comment: ENTRADAS.COM — MALAGA-PROVINCE MUSIC/EVENT INVENTORY. Built 2026-09-28, twin of eci_malaga_map.json (same purpose, same discipline: read the seller's own city listing directly, only ever emit a URL that was actually seen). PURPOSE: entradas_aff() only ever wraps a link that is ALREADY entradas.com — nothing actively checks whether entradas.com sells an act whose current link routes to a non-paying seller (unlike ECI, which has eci_malaga_resolve() + this file's twin doing exactly that check at build time). Sofia, 2026-09-28, after the ECI-side check came back clean: 'yes, but double check that what you will build won't upset any other build' — see entradas_malaga_resolve() in build_site.py for the safety discussion (idempotent, never moves a reader off an already-paying seller, only fires when nothing else already earns). SOURCE: https://www.entradas.com/city/malaga-490/ (entradas.com's own Malaga-city listing — the same city id 'malaga-490' Tools/agent/entradas_tours_scrape.py already uses for MT&M, so this is a proven, working URL, not a guess). Read directly in the Claude Browser tool 2026-09-28 (this machine's sandbox is NOT IP-blocked by entradas.com, unlike ECI — no browser hand-off was needed this time). REFRESH from the same URL whenever the window rolls; this snapshot is 25 events, the whole list the page returned (no pagination / 'load more' control was present).
note_price: Price was not visible in this listing page's cards (unlike ECI's per-event pages, which is where eci_malaga_map.json's eci_from figures came from) - omitted rather than guessed. Not needed for matching: entradas_malaga_resolve() keys on act+date only, same as eci_malaga_resolve().
note_city: entradas.com's own listing labels every one of these 'Málaga' (it is a province-level city-id bucket, id malaga-490), which is WRONG for at least one entry below - flagged inline. Same trap as Niña Pastori on the ECI map ('venue is TORREMOLINOS despite the ECI headline saying en Málaga') - the true city was cross-checked against our own venue_event_map.json where we already carry that venue.

events.venue: Palacio de los Deportes José María Martín Carpena

events.act: Melon Diesel: La gira de Mr Bond

events.city_note: entradas.com's own listing says 'Málaga' - WRONG, cross-checked against our venue_event_map.json where Teatro Auditorio Felipe VI is already carried correctly as Estepona (e.g. Aidalai tribute, 17 Oct).

events.already_wrapped: already the source of our own live entradas.com link for this act/date - confirms the map is reading real, current data.

events.spelling_note: entradas.com spells it 'Kermese' (one s); our own calendar/site say 'Kermesse' (two s) - token match would NOT catch this pair on an exact-word basis. Already wrapped via our existing entradas.com link for this act/date, so harmless today, but noted since it is exactly the kind of near-miss the whole-word matcher is blind to.

events.act: El Desembarco, la traición de Viriato
